info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights ERx Gaps API

params.name: page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date. Default is 0

params.name: parameters[date]
params.description: Date to query for calendar data. Shorthand for date_from and date_to if they are the same. Defaults for latest

params.name: updated
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated

items.docs: Returns earnings reaction gap data, which tracks significant price gaps following earnings announcements
